## Who

**MGB Lab (Microbial Genomics & Biodegradation Lab)**
Group Leader: Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen, Tenure Track Assistant Professor
Section for Microbial Ecology and Biotechnology
Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN)
University of Copenhagen (UCPH), Denmark
Website: https://ku-mgb.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/KU-MGB
Contact (Group Leader): tkn@plen.ku.dk

---

## Research Focus

Microbial evolution and mobile genetic elements, with a primary focus on the
biodegradation of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), including
trifluoroacetate (TFA). Methods combine environmental DNA sequencing
(metagenomics, Nanopore sequencing), AI-driven bioinformatics (HMM searches,
structural homology, machine learning classifiers), structural modelling
(AlphaFold, Boltz-2), and experimental validation (fluoride-release assays,
steady-state kinetics) to discover and engineer dehalogenase enzymes capable
of cleaving the carbon-fluorine bond.

---

## Key Software & Tools Developed

- **DeFluorX** — Automated, reproducible pipeline identifying and prioritising
  fluoroacetate dehalogenase (FAcD) variants for PFAS defluorination, combining
  AI-driven modelling with physics-aware validation (WaterMap, molecular
  dynamics, QM/MM). GitHub: https://github.com/KU-MGB/DeFluorX (private,
  public release pending)
- **HADefluorX** — Companion pipeline covering Haloacid Dehalogenases (HADs),
  applying the same AI-driven screening to identify HAD variants capable of
  cleaving the carbon-fluorine bond.
  GitHub: https://github.com/KU-MGB/HADefluorX (private, public release pending)
- **GenDeFluorX** — Screens in-house-sequenced bacterial whole genomes against
  trifluoroacetate (TFA) to pinpoint the enzyme responsible for its
  defluorination.
  GitHub: https://github.com/KU-MGB/GenDeFluorX (private, public release pending)

---

## Current Projects

- Mapping the PFAS interactome using photocatalytic proximity labelling
  (Active — Novo Nordisk Foundation)
- Sapere Aude: Solving microbial degradation of PFAS (Active — DFF Research
  Leader project)
- Genetics of PFOS biodegradation (Finished 2026 — Danmarks Frie Forskningsfond)

## Disambiguation

MGB Lab refers to the Microbial Genomics & Biodegradation research group led
by Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen at the University of Copenhagen's Department of
Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN) — not to be confused with other
"MGB" acronyms (e.g. Mass General Brigham) in unrelated fields.
